# telnyx_virtual_cross_connect_coverage (Data Source)

The cloud provider regions available for virtual cross connects in each location.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_cloud_provider` (String) The Virtual Private Cloud provider. One of `aws`, `azure`, `gce`.
- `filter_cloud_provider_region` (String) The region of specific cloud provider.
- `filter_location_code` (String) The code of associated location to filter on.
- `filter_location_pop` (String) The POP of associated location to filter on.
- `filter_location_region` (String) The region of associated location to filter on.
- `filter_location_site` (String) The site of associated location to filter on.
- `filters_available_bandwidth` (String)
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `virtual_cross_connect_coverage` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--virtual_cross_connect_coverage))

<a id="nestedatt--virtual_cross_connect_coverage"></a>
### Nested Schema for `virtual_cross_connect_coverage`

Read-Only:

- `available_bandwidth` (List of Number) The available throughput in Megabits per Second (Mbps) for your Virtual Cross Connect.
- `cloud_provider` (String) The Virtual Private Cloud with which you would like to establish a cross connect.
- `cloud_provider_region` (String) The region where your Virtual Private Cloud hosts are located. Should be identical to how the cloud provider names region, i.e. us-east-1 for AWS but Frankfurt for Azure
- `location` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--virtual_cross_connect_coverage--location))
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.

<a id="nestedatt--virtual_cross_connect_coverage--location"></a>
### Nested Schema for `virtual_cross_connect_coverage.location`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) Location code.
- `name` (String) Human readable name of location.
- `pop` (String) Point of presence of location.
- `region` (String) Identifies the geographical region of location.
- `site` (String) Site of location.
